en: Dependent on a phenomenon with a condition, a phenomenon without a condition arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
One under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
A phenomenon with a condition is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a phenomenon without a condition.
A state that is not a non-condition is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is not a non-condition.

(Abbreviated. Under root: one; under object: two; under predominance: two … pe … under decisive support: two … pe … under non-disappearance: one. (The conditioned is the same as the conditioned-with-conditions.)
